title: Source and docs: Intel has given access to its Atom processor tech to Rosaic, a new startup led by Amarjit Gill; Lip-Bu Tan and Gill are longtime co-investors (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Source and docs: Intel has given access to its Atom processor tech to Rosaic, a new startup led by Amarjit Gill; Lip-Bu Tan and Gill are longtime co-investors — Intel (INTC.O) has provided access to some of its processor technology to a new startup, according to a source and documents reviewed by Reuters …
